about:
Global Textile Alliance, Inc. (GTA USA) was founded in 2001 in Reidsville, North Carolina, by principals who each brought two decades of textile and bedding industry experience. The company was established to serve the bedding and furniture markets from a global perspective, leveraging a heritage that traces back to a Belgian weaving mill with fabric production knowledge since 1953.

The Reidsville facility operates as a vertical mill, integrating warping, weaving, circular knitting, and finishing under one roof. In-house yarn extrusion produces ecological yarns, while fabric formation technology and a quality-control lab support the development of mattress, upholstery, and curtain fabrics. Design, development, and sales teams collaborate on site, using trend research to create unique constructions, patterns, and colorations for brands including GTA USA, Ter Molst, and Symphony Mills—all part of the Love Home Fabrics group.

GTA USA supplies the bedding and furniture industries, providing mattress ticking, headboard and border fabrics, and upholstery materials for residential and contract markets. Its customer base includes manufacturers seeking domestic capacity with the flexibility to adjust to changing requirements, backed by global sourcing capabilities that mirror the company's European and Indian sister operations.

The company emphasizes local production on a global scale, highlighting sustainability benefits and the ability to respond quickly to shifting demand. Its founding principle centered on combining global reach with the agility to tailor fabrics to specific customer needs, a model that continues to drive its operations today.
